test_case.test_name: Parameterized single-M.2 OS installation, boot and front-HDD idle-LED validation
test_case.purpose: Install an approved supported primary OS onto one designated M.2, boot it successfully after controlled reboot, verify storage health/logs and applicable idle front-HDD LED behavior.
required_package: Signed supported OS image/checksum/license and exact edition/build
M.2 serial/NGUID/slot/BDF plus explicit destructive data-loss authorization
Protected disk-exclusion, partition/bootloader/encryption and firmware/driver plan
KVM/OOB, one-reboot authorization and known-good recovery media/image
Front-HDD-LED applicability/specification, no-I/O interval and operator photo evidence
test_case.test_command: Do not execute during review. After separate destructive authorization, verify image provenance and exact M.2 stable identity while excluding all other OS/data/RAID/mounted devices; perform the logged vendor-supported install and approved reboot through OS Ready; prove active boot disk, partitions, driver/firmware and logs; measure idle I/O and have operator photograph the applicable front HDD LED; retain rollback media.
test_case.expected_result: The approved OS installs only on the designated M.2, boots successfully after the approved reboot with expected storage identity and no M.2 errors, and the applicable front HDD LED is off throughout the defined no-I/O window.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires signed media, exact destructive target, successful install/boot identity, clean M.2 health/logs and physical idle-LED evidence when applicable. IPMI sensor output cannot pass.
safety_gate: Require explicit per-run destructive approval after exact target and partition plan are shown.
Fail closed on any other boot/data/mounted/RAID device ambiguity.
Operator/KVM owns installation/reboot/physical LED observation with recovery media ready.
Abort on target mismatch, installer/boot error, storage health error or missing recovery path; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Variant identity, OS image signature/checksum and support authority
Active boot target, M.2 health and system logs
Measured idle interval, physical LED photo/applicability and recovery disposition
test_case.recovery: On wrong-target indication or failed boot, stop before further writes/retries, preserve installer/partition/boot/health evidence, use only approved KVM/recovery media to restore the known-good image or boot configuration, and require OS/storage owner authorization before another install.
